Later same-element changes, including FHIR-36008 adding ResearchStudy, FHIR-46599 changing the element to CodeableReference, and a later SubstanceDefinition addition, preserved BiologicallyDerivedProduct. Patient Care WGM minutes reference FHIR-31995 among AdverseEvent change requests, and no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative type list already includes http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/BiologicallyDerivedProduct on AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance, so a source edit would be redundant rather than corrective.
